nom: TATCHA The Silk Cream Line-Smoothing & Firming Moisturizer

segments.oily: Reviewers with slightly oily areas describe the cream as balancing, saying it is not oily and works well on combination zones with dry patches.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin (including some in dry climates) report improved hydration, less tightness, and softer texture, though one dry-skin reviewer found it left her face feeling tight and not moisturized under sunscreen.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as lightweight, non-greasy, and well-suited to balancing oily and dry zones.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive or rosacea-prone mostly report no irritation and reduced redness, but a minority describe stinging, redness after a few uses, or an allergic breakout.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin (many in their 60s-70s) report softer, plumper skin and diminished fine lines, though a few say they saw no visible change in lines or wrinkles.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin reports it absorbs well without greasiness and does not cause breakouts.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother texture, fewer fine lines, and firmer-looking skin over weeks to months of use; a couple of reviewers say they saw no change in fine lines despite continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe noticeable hydration, plumping, and relief from dryness or itching, but one reviewer with a dry environment found it left skin tight and not truly moisturized.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea-prone or redness-prone skin generally report calming effects and no flare-ups; one reviewer reports stinging and new redness after a few applications.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention restored comfort and balance after dryness or irritation from other products, describing quick relief of itching and dryness.
concerns.spots: Some mature-skin reviewers mention sunspots or pigmentation persisting despite otherwise positive results, while one reports improvement in hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts say the cream does not cause them and is safe for breakout-prone skin, but several others explicitly report new or worsened acne, including cystic or under-skin breakouts, after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the texture as hydrating without oiliness or greasy residue, including those with combination or slightly oily areas.

aspects.libelle: High price relative to jar size

extraits.titre: I haven't broken out like this before!
extraits.texte: Unfortunately, this is not for me. After a short time of excitedly using this cream daily, I started getting under the skin acne, which I have never had before like this. It kept getting worse. I finally put two and two together and stopped using this product and the under skin acne stopped. I am 47 years old and have not had skin like this even when I was a teen. I try a lot if different products and do not have sensitive skin… this is a first. Could just be me though.
